items.reason: A lower-strength retinol is a gentle way to start a night routine aimed at the look of fine lines.
A light ceramide moisturizer helps skin feel more comfortable and hydrated while it gets used to retinol.
A daily mineral SPF 50 is needed alongside retinol, which makes skin more sun-sensitive.

response.routine_note: Start with retinol two nights a week after cleansing, moisturize after it, then build up slowly as skin feels comfortable. Apply sunscreen every morning and reapply when outdoors.
